leadText:
Sayuri Ichiishi (Japanese: ) is the former lead character designer for and currently works for OLM, Inc. 

In addition to this, she worked as an animation director in the first episode and Mewtwo Returns, and as an illustrator for the Pokémon Trading Card Game. The single card that she illustrated, , was a promotion for Camp Pikachu, a Pikachu short for which she had worked as the character designer. 

Up to Pokémon Journeys: The Series, she occasionally worked on a few episodes as key animator and for this series up through the beginning of Pokémon Horizons: The Series, she did work regularly as a key animator for multiple episodes. Additionally, she does help with the creation of each Pokémon movie, was involved in the animation of The Moment of Lumiose Truth!, and has been credited as an animation director for one episode of Pokémon the Series: XY, several episodes of Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon and one episode of Pokémon Journeys: The Series.
